# Annotation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Annotation`](gmeow-Annotation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Annotation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notes`](../../slices/notes.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A reified binding of a body to a target with a motivation — the W3C Web [`Annotation`](gmeow-Annotation.md) idiom expressed as a [gufo:Relator.](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Relator.) Mediates [`annotationBody`](../properties/gmeow-annotationBody.md) (the note or literal), [`annotationTarget`](../properties/gmeow-annotationTarget.md) (the annotated entity), and [`annotationMotivation`](../properties/gmeow-annotationMotivation.md) (the purpose). A highlight is an [`Annotation`](gmeow-Annotation.md) with a target span but no body; a bookmark is an [`Annotation`](gmeow-Annotation.md) motivated by bookmarking. [`Standpoint`](gmeow-Standpoint.md), confidence, and suppression are carried by the relator's provenance layer ([`accordingTo`](../properties/gmeow-accordingTo.md), displayable) or by RDF-star annotations on the shortcut.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Annotation`](gmeow-Annotation.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: notes and annotations. A gmeow:Note is a first-class
# information object — authored, timestamped, and linked to other notes by
# gmeow:hasWikilink and to entities by gmeow:mentions (the Zettelkasten / linked-
# note pattern). A gmeow:Highlight is the W3C-Web-Annotation shape for pure
# highlighting: a gmeow:annotationTarget, a precise gmeow:annotationTargetSpan
# (a text-quote Selector), and a gmeow:annotationMotivation — but NO body (a
# highlight just marks a span; for an annotation that says something, a body-
# bearing gmeow:Annotation subclass is used). A gmeow:Comment is a Note that
# threads under a parent.

@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/notes/> .
```
